name: Post-render / assembler export QA
rule: Run on every connected export OR emit this checklist for human assemblers before calling a package done. Does not replace lint-package.mjs (markdown gate).
when_not_rendered: If Render status is NOT_RENDERED, mark all checks N/A — checklist emitted for the finisher; do not claim PASS.

checks.ask: Hands/fingers anatomically OK across frames (no warps, merges, extras)?
checks.fail_if: Warped or extra fingers in hero/talent beats
checks.fix: Regenerate that unit or cut away; prefer still hold

checks.ask: On-screen model text/logo is absent or intentional; no garbled/melted type?
checks.fail_if: Melted pack labels, gibberish UI, model-drawn logo as final brand mark
checks.fix: Remove; burn real text/logo in CapCut from sheet assets

checks.fail_if: Colorway, silhouette, face, or facility drifts vs Image-N refs
checks.fix: Re-bind refs; regenerate drifted unit only

checks.ask: VO/music/SFX aligned; no overlapping mismatched beds; lip sync acceptable if dialogue?
checks.fail_if: Double beds, offset VO, uncanny lip flop on talking head
checks.fix: Re-lay audio in post; mute gen audio if needed

checks.ask: Motion continuous where intended; no accidental freeze or stutter holding as a 'shot'?
checks.fail_if: Dead freeze mid-demo unless intentional hold frame

checks.ask: Export length matches media plan and timed script (±0.5s)?
checks.fail_if: 15s plan shipped as 7s or 40s without stated reason
checks.fix: Re-time assembly; split or extend units intentionally

checks.ask: Endcard uses official logo asset; safe margins; not logo-first cold open?
checks.fail_if: Model-invented logo; endcard colliding with UI chrome; logo opens the spot
checks.fix: Rebuild endcard in post from SVG/PNG

checks.ask: 0–3s works with sound off (text or pure visual interrupt)?
checks.fail_if: Joke/hook only works with audio; blank first seconds
checks.fix: Add burned hook text or stronger visual interrupt

checks.ask: Finished cut still has exactly one primary CTA?
checks.fix: Strip secondary CTAs to caption/primary text only

checks.ask: Required aspects are separate exports (not naive center-crop)?
checks.fail_if: 16:9 letterbox dumped to TikTok; faces cropped off

checks.ask: No invented metrics/reviews appeared in burn-ins during finish?
checks.fail_if: Editor added '94%' or fake stars not in ledger
checks.fix: Remove or replace with PLACEHOLDER/USER_SUPPLIED only

checks.ask: Render log lists real job/export ids for every claimed PASS unit?
checks.fail_if: Package says rendered PASS with empty log

ship_rule: Connected/assembler exports: all applicable checks PASS or N/A with reason before Render status PASS. Handoff-only: emit checklist for finisher; keep NOT_RENDERED.
